Tuesday.notes: Keep it relaxed at low effort — this sets the tone for a strong week ahead.

Wednesday.notes: Focus on functional movements and flexibility to support your running performance.

Thursday.notes: Push comfortably hard in the middle 20 minutes — aim for around 140–145 bpm to build your aerobic threshold.

Friday.notes: Let your body absorb Thursday's effort — a gentle stroll is perfect if you feel restless.

Saturday.notes: Match last week's long run effort and distance around 10km, keeping heart rate steady below 145 bpm.

Sunday.notes: Full recovery today — you've earned it after a solid week of training.

Monday.notes: Keep the pace conversational and heart rate under 120 bpm to flush out fatigue before the next cycle.
